M-PROPERTY-REF.Purpose: Owner-neutral reference to a reactive Behavior property slot, exposing read/write access and notifications when its occupant changes.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: IPropertyRef and IPropertyRef<T>: slot identity, owner, Get/Set, Changing and Changed events for Widget and FVP property owners.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: BindRef/WatchRef subscription policies, which decide whether to follow a particular Behavior instance or the slot across replacement.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Action orchestration and property-replacement interruption, owned by M-TIMELINE-BEHAVIOR.

Principles.PRIN-001: Property refs expose the slot itself; they do not dictate how callers interpret replacement or completion of behavior execution.

Requirements.REQ-001: Every acquired subscription is owned and released by its subscriber (e.g. BindRef/WatchRef policy or an executing Timeline action); the slot does not retain event subscription ownership.
Requirements.REQ-002: Changing fires before real replacement and Changed after it; a SemEquals short-circuit produces neither event. Consumers may use Changing to interrupt observation before Reset of the previous occupant can emit OnComplete.
Requirements.REQ-003: Get returns the current occupant and Set delegates to generated property semantics for both Widget and ordinary FVP owners, including activation and SemEquals handling.

Inputs.IN-001: slot owner, property name and optional typed Behavior assignment.

Outputs.OUT-001: current Behavior instance occupying the slot.
Outputs.OUT-002: Changing and Changed notifications on real replacement.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Set may mutate the property and invoke its existing activation/release mechanisms.
